outcome: Add genuinely recommended, source-backed, detailed trails for underrepresented Sharon and Lowlands areas without publishing filler or closed routes.
authorizationBoundary: Implement and verify locally; do not publish without an explicit deployment instruction.
invariants: every route fact links to an official source
every new public image has an identified source, credit and license
existing trails and filters remain available
acceptance: Eight detailed routes are added across Sharon and Lowlands.
Each route includes route plan, family fit, accessibility, highlights and safety guidance.
Sharon and Lowlands have dedicated discovery topics that prefilter correctly.
Trail counts are derived from data rather than hardcoded.
Desktop and mobile rendering, build and trail-family tests pass.
